title: The Multimodal Paradox: How Added and Missing Modalities Shape Bias and Performance in Multimodal AI

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating and comparing Demographic Parity (DP) and True Positive Rate (TPR) metrics for White and Non-White patient groups in medical classification tasks (like predicting ICU admission) as different input modalities are added or removed.

Calculating and comparing Demographic Parity (DP) and True Positive Rate (TPR) metrics for Female and Male patient groups in medical classification tasks as different input modalities are added or removed.
